claims.content: To allow users to extract the contents of a compressed archive in one of the supported by PeaZip formats, and also allows extraction of those contents in non-compressed format too, in order to be used according to users’ desires.

goal.raw_text: To allow users to extract the contents of a compressed archive in one of the supported by PeaZip formats, and also allows extraction of those contents in non-compressed format too, in order to be used according to users’ desires.

claims.content: User
The user must have selected a compressed archive object in one of the supported formats to extract.
If the selected archive is encrypted (locked), the user must possess the necessary password and/or keyfile.

The user selects an archive to be extracted from the file manager interface and initiates the extraction process, for example by pressing the 'Extract' button or using the 'Go to extraction layout' option.

trigger.raw_text: The user selects an archive to be extracted from the file manager interface and initiates the extraction process, for example by pressing the 'Extract' button or using the 'Go to extraction layout' option.

claims.content: The system displays the Extraction Interface (Extraction window).
The user chooses the storage space in the computer system where the extracted files will be saved.
The user defines what should happen in case of existence of a homonym file or archive in the selected storage space.
If the archive is encrypted, the user inserts the password and/or keyfile.
The system extracts the contents of the compressed archive.
The system provides a graphic display of information and currently executed functions' progress (PeaLauncher).
The user can initiate the extraction process via the 'Drag and Drop Feature' directly into the Extract Interface.
From the File Manager Interface, the user can select 'Go to extraction layout' from the Browser menu to access the Extract Interface directly.
If the archive is encrypted (locked) and the user does not provide the correct password or keyfile, the system will not allow extraction.
The system may display errors during extraction if backend binaries encounter issues, as indicated by PeaLauncher keeping open only if needed (errors, list, test...).
The contents of the compressed archive are successfully extracted to the user-specified storage space.
The system displays a 'Job successfully completed' status in the graphic display window (PeaLauncher).
The progress window provides details on the Input size, Output size, and Time taken for the extraction process.
